verdict.rationale:
Bento explicitly documents tying revenue back to the email or flow that preceded it, purchase events with amount/product details, and unique-event deduplication to avoid double-counting revenue from reloads/retries — directly enabling revenue attribution beyond opens/clicks. Workflows/flows are built from behavior and events, supporting flow-level attribution.

missing for 10: a documented attribution report/dashboard UI showing per-email or per-flow revenue rollups, and independent/hands-on corroboration of attribution accuracy.
